en.headline: HKU wins ABU Robocon 2026 as both local teams reach final
en.dek: The University of Hong Kong team defeated the Chinese University of Hong Kong 240-100 in the final of the Asia-Pacific Broadcasting Union robotics contest held at Queen Elizabeth Stadium.
body: Hong Kong hosted the ABU Robocon 2026 on Sunday for the first time in 14 years, with 16 university teams from 15 countries and regions competing at Queen Elizabeth Stadium under the theme Kung Fu Quest. Both local representatives, HKU and CUHK, reached the final.

HKU’s Sapientia team, known as 格物, beat CUHK’s Power Builder side 240-100 to claim the championship. The contest required pairs of robots to collaborate on forging traditional Chinese weapons, collecting martial-arts manuals and completing strategic duels.

About 2,000 spectators attended, including more than 650 participants and supporters from the mainland and overseas. Financial Secretary Paul Chan spoke at the opening, stressing the value of turning ideas into working machines under real constraints. The event was co-organised by RTHK and the Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation.

zh.headline: 亞太廣播聯盟機械人大賽港大奪冠 中大屈居亞軍
zh.dek: 亞太廣播聯盟機械人大賽周日於伊利沙伯體育館舉行，港大「格物」隊決賽以240比100擊敗中大「功無不克」隊奪冠。
body: 香港相隔14年再辦亞太廣播聯盟機械人大賽，16支來自15個國家及地區的大學隊伍周日於伊利沙伯體育館以「武林至尊」為主題競技。港大及中大兩支本地隊伍雙雙殺入決賽。
港大「格物」隊最終以240比100擊敗中大「功無不克」隊奪得冠軍。賽事要求兩部機械人協作鑄造中式武器、蒐集武林秘笈，並在策略對決中完成任務。
約2000人入場，包括逾650名內地及海外參賽者與支持者。財政司司長陳茂波在開幕禮致辭，強調把構想化為實體機械人的價值。賽事由香港電台與香港科技園公司合辦。
